card.name: Of before quality in old prose
card.fires_on: Small words like "of", "it", "the", "some" in 19th-century style historical or biographical prose, especially "of" after a noun like man, school, town, or people and before a quality such as education, grades, or station.

modes.label: Of introducing a quality
modes.description: "of" after a person or place noun, leading into a description of character, rank, or size.
modes.example: was a man<< of>> thorough education and sterling character.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short words such as "it", "the", "some", "such" in the middle of old-fashioned narrative sentences.
modes.example: a poetess of<< some>> distinction, and her early schoolmate at

card.plain: It fires on small linking words in old-fashioned history and biography, mostly "of" before a description like "good family" or "high station".
